# NEW MULTIPLAYER OPEN BETA!!👥

Enjoy Scan or Scam with your friends and become the best cashier in town.

In multiplayer, 2 to 6 players compete to earn the most money from a shared set of customers. When the rush ends, the richest cashier wins.

And if fast scanning is not enough, use the Grabber to steal items straight from your neighbors’ conveyor belts.

Please note that multiplayer is still in beta access and may contain bugs.
Feel free to give us feedback on Discord, it is greatly appreciated!

# Join our discord and become a launcher!

https://discord.gg/TKAhFrUjcq

# Scan, weigh, sell! 🛒
Welcome to the checkout counter! Scan items, weigh fruits and veggies, stock your display, and run your shop like a pro 👔

[media]

Buy and resell shady items 🕵️‍♂️
Sketchy customers will offer you strange goods. Negotiate the right price, resell them on the sly, and rake in the cash without raising suspicion 👀

[media]

Stay out of trouble 🚓
The cops stop by from time to time, so make sure to hide illegal items under the counter or risk a hefty fine ⚠️

[media]

Keep Karen in line 😈
If a customer is bothering you, who’s going to stop you from making sure they never come back?

[media]

Upgrade your shop 💎
Invest your cash to improve your store and sell even more crazy stuff.

[media]

Collect brainrots 🧠
Buy eggs containing brainrot figures. Keep them, or sell them for a high price.

[media]

Food services 🌭
Your convenience store now also serves food and drinks.
